text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: Aren't you pushing yourself too hard?
Aren't you overdoing it a little?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?
If anything, this isn't nearly enough!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The food the strong ones eat!
The workouts the strong ones do!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll incorporate both and get a body just like that...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I mean, why do all Umamusume
eat so darn much anyway?!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(And thanks to that, I ended up
gaining more weight than I expected...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit! Until I properly lose the weight!
I am absolutely! Not stopping my training!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin kept up her relentless strength training after that and successfully managed to lose the weight.
